nodes.description: Emilin1 binds proTGF-beta and prevents its maturation by furin convertases; Emilin1 knockout mice show increased TGF-beta signaling in the vascular wall. The defining human report describes aberrant growth factor signaling, but which human phenotypes this contributes to is not established in the cited sources, so no causal edge to a phenotype is drawn.

nodes.description: Without EMILIN1, the elastogenic protein EFEMP2 (fibulin-4) is poorly deposited in the extracellular matrix and lysyl oxidase (LOX) levels and enzyme activity fall, shown in patient material and in Emilin1 knockout mice. This places EMILIN1 deficiency on the same EFEMP2-LOX axis as EFEMP2-related cutis laxa type 1B.
